title: PDF Text & Metadata Extractor input
description: Paste one or more public PDF URLs. Each successfully extracted PDF is one billable result; URLs that cannot be downloaded or are not PDFs are reported for free.

urls.title: PDF URLs
urls.description: One public PDF URL per line (or a JSON array of URLs). Redirects are followed. Duplicates are removed automatically.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: `text` returns the plain text in the `text` field. `markdown` returns a `markdown` field with headings guessed from font sizes and page breaks rendered as horizontal rules (`---`). `both` returns both fields.

perPage.title: Include per-page text
perPage.description: Add a `pages` array with the text and character count of every page. Turn off to keep records smaller when you only need the full text.

extractLinks.title: Extract links
extractLinks.description: Collect unique URLs from link annotations and from the text into a `links` array.

maxPages.title: Max pages per PDF
maxPages.description: Only the first N pages are extracted. `pageCount` always reports the real number of pages.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: PDFs larger than this are skipped (reported as `too-large`, not billed). The limit is enforced from the Content-Length header and again while downloading.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many PDFs to download and parse in parallel. Large PDFs use more memory; lower this if the run hits memory limits.

timeoutSecs.title: Download timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a PDF download after this many seconds.
